role.altitude: Her week is still the equipment in front of the customer and the parts in her hands. She stops paging a manual when a control card is already filled, and she stops walking the aisle for a bin when the bin is already on the ticket.
skills_to_grow: Show the control herself even when the card lists it
Leave a blank function line unread rather than guess it
Match the part in her hand to the ticket before she leaves the aisle
Treat a blank bin as a search she still does
role.ambitious_version: She still demonstrates every piece of equipment and still carries every part. A blank control card or a blank bin stays her work, and neither list speaks to the customer.

tasks.short: Show customers how the equipment works and explain the functioning.

steps.what: List the stored controls for this equipment.
Demonstrate that equipment to the customers.
Explain the functioning of the equipment to those customers.

tasks.design: The parts catalog in {OTHER} lists equipment id, control name and the stored function line only when those fields are already filled. She demonstrates the equipment to the customers and explains the functioning herself. The list does not speak, does not fill a sheet, and does not send an alert.
tasks.previous_blocker: What each control does sat in a paper manual or in her memory, and the customer was already standing at the equipment.
tasks.enabler_now: A catalog can show a control name and a function line that a maintainer already stored. That is a screen of stored fields, not a substitute for showing the equipment.
tasks.still_hard: A customer who has not used the equipment needs the motion shown. A blank or wrong function line is not something she should read aloud.
tasks.human_edge: She sees whether the customer's hands followed the control, and she stops the equipment if they did not.
tasks.altitude: She still demonstrates the equipment and still explains the functioning. She stops paging a manual when the control card is filled. She gains no right to let a screen speak to the customer.

reach.task: Explain how a rented tool works at the counter.
reach.learn: Which control names are already on the rental card, so a blank card is not read out as if it were filled.

evidence.claim: Bol Shophulp asks follow-up questions and compares features, price and delivery. That is a shop assistant for merchandise. This task's list only shows a control name and a function line already stored in the catalog. It does not ask the customer questions, and it does not demonstrate the equipment.
A shopping chatbot must say it is AI. This design has no chatbot and no assistant speaking to the customer. The date named for that duty is 2 August 2026.
The range is a scenario for a parts counter where the demonstration is in person. It is not a published time study. Model knowledge.

assumptions: Control-card fields are equipment id, control name and a short function line. The producer is the catalog maintainer, who stored them before this task. That capture is outside this task and is not counted as time saved.
If equipment id, control name or the function line is blank, the list step does not run and she uses the paper manual. A blank line is not filled by a guess.
Demonstrating the equipment and explaining the functioning stay at full time. The only shortened step is hunting the manual when the card is already filled.
The list does not speak to the customer, does not fill a sheet, and does not send an alert. She does not read a function line the card does not hold.

Upkeep is 0.2 hours per 100 baseline hours of this task, for telling the catalog maintainer that a stored function line is wrong. That telling is her own speech. The list does not send it. Time inside the demonstration is not deducted again.
unknowns: Whether this catalog stores a control name and a function line, or only a part number and a price.
How often the equipment she demonstrates is the one the card was written for.
research_questions: On a week of demonstrations, how often is the control card filled before she starts?
When the card is filled, does she still open the manual?

incremental.description: Tell the catalog maintainer when a stored function line is wrong. The list does not send that message.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When equipment id, control name and the function line are already stored, she skips paging the manual before she starts. When any of those is blank, or the card is for a different piece, she uses the manual and the saving is near zero. Demonstrating the equipment and explaining the functioning are not shortened.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Pick up the parts and deliver them to the counter.

steps.what: List the bin and quantity for these parts.
Pick up those parts from the shelf or the named bin.
Deliver the parts to the customer at the counter.
Write the delivered quantity on the parts ticket.

tasks.design: The parts stock record in {OTHER} lists part number, quantity and bin for the ticket only when those fields are already stored. She picks up the parts, delivers them to the customer, and writes the quantity on the ticket herself. The list does not pick, does not deliver, does not fill a sheet, and does not send an alert.
tasks.previous_blocker: The bin was a memory or a pencil note on the ticket, and the part still had to be carried to the counter.
tasks.enabler_now: A stock record can show a bin that someone already maintains. The walk and the hand-over do not become a screen step because a code is visible.
tasks.still_hard: An empty bin, a part that only looks like the one on the ticket, and a customer at the wrong counter are still hers to sort out.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell the part in her hand from a near match, and she is the person who puts it in the customer's hands.
tasks.altitude: She still picks up the parts and still delivers them. She stops searching the aisle for a location when the bin is stored. She still writes the quantity, and she does not gain a right to mark a part delivered without carrying it.

reach.task: Hand paid goods across after the ticket is closed.
reach.learn: Which ticket is already paid, so an unpaid line is not treated as ready to deliver.

evidence.claim: A tool fit to monitor staff needs works-council consent. A log of how fast each salesperson walks a pick would be that kind of tool. This list shows the bin and does not keep a score of her walking.
The range is a scenario for walking parts from a shelf to a counter. It is not a published time study. Model knowledge.

assumptions: Pick-list fields are ticket id, part number, quantity and bin. The producer of the ticket id, part number and quantity is whoever took the parts order before this task. The producer of the bin is whoever maintains the stock location. Both captures are outside this task and are not counted as time saved.
If part number, quantity or bin is blank, the list step does not run and she reads the paper ticket and finds the shelf herself. A missing bin is not invented.
Picking up the parts, delivering them and writing the quantity stay at full time. The only shortened step is hunting the bin when it is already stored.
The list does not pick the part, does not deliver it, does not fill a sheet, and does not send an alert. It does not record how long she took.

Upkeep is 0.2 hours per 100 baseline hours of this task, for telling the stock clerk when the named bin is empty. That telling is her own speech. The list does not send it. The walk stays in the pickup step and is not deducted again.
unknowns: Whether bins are maintained on the stock record for the parts she walks.
How often the named bin is empty when she arrives.
research_questions: On a week of tickets, how often is the bin filled before she leaves the counter?
When the bin is filled, how often is that location empty or holding a different part?

incremental.description: Tell the stock clerk when the named bin is empty. The list does not send that message.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When ticket id, part number, quantity and bin are already stored, she skips searching the aisle for the location. When the bin is blank, empty, or holding a different part, she searches as today and the saving is near zero. Picking up the parts, delivering them and writing the quantity are not shortened.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
